+import os

+            "model": OPENAI_TTS_MODEL,
+            "input": text,
+            "voice": voice,
+            "format": format,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+    audio_bytes = response.content
+    if output is not None:
+        path = Path(output)
+        path.write_bytes(audio_bytes)
+        return str(path)
+
+    if as_bytes:
+        return audio_bytes
+
+    return base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode("ascii")
